column1: # Forever Mining: the new ores and their vein drops of spec jvbastel/WOWAI#225 (ticket #232). forever/generator writes
# the ores into forever_item_template and the drops into forever_gameobject_loot_template (world database). The core
# reads both only with Forever.Rules = 1. Smelting does not change. Never edit a generated file by hand. To gather
# the data again, see forever/REFRESH.md.
# Source: WoW Forever build 1.60.1.70685, recorded 2026-10-30: the local Forever client (items.tsv and locks.tsv of
# the #224 dump: Pyrite 249391, Bauxite 249425 and Pitchblende 249426 are "Scarce" uncommon ores, stack 20), and the
# stock 1.12 world DB of the batch slot (gameobject_template, gameobject_loot_template; notes/forever/
# explore-professions.md 5a). The client has no drop rates and no spawns: the rates below are the spec's choice.
# Only numbers and names.
# Rates (the `rate` column):
#   spec      the spec's rate: Pyrite drops from the Copper and Tin Veins at the stock Malachite/Tigerseye rate, 1%
#             in loot group 1 with the stock gems (one gem of the group at most per vein).
#   fallback  a stand-in until launch data gives a rate (a later ticket after 4 November): the stock gem rate of
#             the vein (group 0). Bauxite: Iron 1% (Lesser Moonstone), Mithril 0.7% (Aquamarine, Star Ruby).
#             Pitchblende: Small Thorium 0.7% (Blue Sapphire, Huge Emerald), Rich Thorium 0.8% (Huge Emerald).
# Pitchblende is the #230 item 70002 (items.tsv): it survives the dead-content rule because Smelt Azerothium uses
# it. If the rule cuts it, the generator leaves its drops out and lists them in the cut list.
# Not ported (Forever mining content with no 1.12 home, spec #225 "Out of Scope"):
#   - the Heavy Thorium Vein and its lock 4170 (Mining 300): a `cut` row, so the cut list shows it. Its ore
#     (Heavy Thorium Ore, items.tsv) and Smelt Heavy Thorium (Molten Foundry) are cut by the dead-content rule.
#   - lock 38 (Copper Vein) needs Mining 1 in Forever, 0 in stock: Lock.dbc is not patched, the stock value stays.
#   - the ore stack size 20 (stock 10): the ores copy their stock source row.
# Columns (tab-separated); "-" where a column does not apply to the kind.
#   kind         ore: a new ore item, from the free item range (items.tsv names it), a copy of sourceItem
#                drop: an ore in the loot of one vein loot ID
#                cut: Forever mining content that is not ported; the generator lists it in the cut list
#   item         ore and drop: the item ID of the ore. cut: the Forever ID that the row names (a lock)
#   name         the ore name, or what a cut row names
#   sourceItem, quality, itemLevel, displayId, sellPrice, foreverItem
#                ore only: as in items.tsv (displayId: a stock ItemDisplayInfo.dbc ID; sellPrice in copper)
#   vein         drop: the vein name
#   gameobjects  drop: the stock gameobject_template entries that use the loot ID (data1); the SQL fails if one
#                does not
#   lootId       drop: the gameobject_loot_template entry
#   chance       drop: the drop chance in percent
#   groupid      drop: the loot group (0: an own roll)
#   rate         drop: spec or fallback (see above)
#   notes        free text
